name: vscode-tmux-auto-reattach
description: On window open, opens one integrated terminal per existing tmux (or zellij) session and attaches to it.

commands.title: tmux Auto Reattach: Open One Terminal Per Session

tmuxAutoReattach.runOnStartup.description: Automatically open a terminal per session when the window finishes loading.

tmuxAutoReattach.listCommand.description: Shell command (run on the host where the workspace lives) that prints one session name per line. For zellij use: zellij list-sessions -ns

tmuxAutoReattach.attachCommand.description: Command run inside each new terminal. {session} is replaced with the session name. Add -d to kick other clients off the session: tmux attach -d -t {session}. For zellij: zellij attach {session}

tmuxAutoReattach.skipIfTerminalsOpen.description: Do nothing on startup if any terminal is already open. Prevents duplicate tabs when VSCode revives terminals after a reload.

tmuxAutoReattach.liveTitles.description: Let tmux drive each terminal tab's title (so it can show the running program) instead of using a fixed session-name label. Requires tmux set-titles, which titleCommand enables for you. tmux-only; leave off for zellij.

tmuxAutoReattach.titleCommand.default: tmux set -g set-titles on \; set -g set-titles-string '#{session_name}: #{pane_current_command}'
tmuxAutoReattach.titleCommand.description: Only used when liveTitles is on. Run in each terminal (before attaching) to make tmux emit tab titles. Note set-titles is a global tmux option, so this affects all sessions on the server. Clear this if you set set-titles in ~/.tmux.conf yourself.

tmuxAutoReattach.shellPath.description: Path to a shell used to run the attach command directly, bypassing your default terminal profile. Set this if your default profile auto-launches tmux, otherwise the attach nests inside a fresh tmux. Example: /bin/sh or /bin/bash (use an absolute path on the host where the workspace lives). Leave empty to use the default profile (the original behaviour).

tmuxAutoReattach.shellArgs.description: Arguments passed to shellPath before the attach command. Only used when shellPath is set. Use ["-l", "-c"] for a login shell if tmux isn't on PATH otherwise.
